project: Public Quest platform evidence for a seated social card application

workload.reason: A current official compatibility matrix is required before freezing the native foundation toolchain and physical-device gate; this does not repeat the accepted audience, comfort, culture, comparable-product or music-rights research.

public_research_query: Using only current official public primary sources from Meta, Epic Games, Khronos, and Android, produce a dated compatibility and implementation evidence matrix for building and physically validating a native Unreal Engine 5.7.4 seated social card application on Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S. Cover: supported Meta XR/Interaction SDK and OpenXR paths; controller and hand-tracking coexistence/live switching; passthrough mixed reality, Scene API, spatial anchors, room placement and recovery; Meta Avatars or presence integration and fallback constraints; Android SDK/NDK/JDK/Gradle/API-level requirements; package/sign/install/launch/device-log steps; multiplayer/two-headset concealed-state verification; performance, haptics, spatial audio, accessibility and store/device limitations. For each row give the official URL, document title, publisher, publication/update date if shown, exact version or limitation stated, confidence, and any contradiction. Prefer at most 10 sources and say NOT ESTABLISHED when official evidence is absent. Do not use private data, repositories, code, forums, blogs, social media, or third-party tutorials, and do not make product, legal, security, or store-approval conclusions.
objective: Return one bounded, cited, current primary-source evidence packet that resolves the implementation and physical-validation matrix needed for the native Quest foundation.
non_goals: No repository, source-code, architecture, private-project, credential, account, Slack, Linear, provider-output or concealed-gameplay context
No duplicate research on audience culture, Bid Whist history, general older-adult comfort, comparable products, host music rights or product direction
No programming, voting, committee verdict, security acceptance, legal conclusion, store approval, implementation authority or external write
constraints: Execute the exact query text and digest once through the official Perplexity API/connector lane
Use at most 10 official primary sources from Meta, Epic Games, Khronos or Android
Record source URL, title, publisher, visible date, exact version/limitation, confidence and contradictions
Mark any unsupported fact NOT ESTABLISHED instead of inferring it
Do not browse or cite private, account-scoped, forum, social-media, third-party tutorial or repository material
Do not expose API keys, cookies, tokens, environment values, browsing history or personal data
allowed_tools: Official Perplexity Search API through the configured Director adapter
allowed_external_effects: Return one authenticated terminal research response with citations
acceptance_checks: Authenticated Perplexity run identity and terminal status are recorded
No private or repository context was transmitted
All material claims have direct official primary-source citations or are marked NOT ESTABLISHED
No more than 10 sources are used and contradictions/unknowns are explicit
OpenAI and Firecrawl independently verify the cited official pages before any implementation decision
evidence_requirements: Provider/model/API surface and authenticated run or request identifier
Raw terminal response retained without secrets
Normalized source matrix with direct URLs and retrieval dates
Independent Firecrawl verification status per source
Known gaps and a clear no-verdict/no-authority disclaimer
approval_requirements: Owner has authorized bounded provider use and asked the Director to use best judgment
Any revised Perplexity query is a new assignment and requires a new exact packet; never silently rerun this query
OpenAI synthesis may accept evidence, but Perplexity cannot issue the product or implementation verdict
